facts.fact: Ghana and the UAE signed a $1bn agreement for an innovation and AI hub at Ningo-Prampram with construction scheduled for 2026, including $180m for an AI Compute Hub to be developed by G42, with the UAE's PCFC financing it (African Business).
The agreement allocates $100m to a national AI-powered digital identity system built on Falcon large language models via AI71, and $120m to a Ghana AI Startup Studio with Hub71.
facts.system: AI-powered digital identity system on Falcon

systems.platform: AI computing, renewable energy and liquid cooling
systems.owner: G42 for the Ghana-UAE hub, financed by PCFC
